latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the CreditClaw–CreditCard skill.

- Enables online shopping for agents with guardrailed wallets and owner-set spending limits.
- Supports multiple payment methods: Pre-paid Wallet, Self-Hosted Card, and Stripe x402 Wallet.
- Includes robust security features, such as server-enforced spending limits, hashed API keys, and real-time owner visibility.
- Provides guides for different merchants (Amazon, Shopify, SaaS, cloud hosting) and payment rails.
- Requires owner approval for every purchase by default; approval modes and limits can be managed via dashboard.
- Offers step-by-step setup instructions and links to all relevant documentation.
